explain XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX.

a:

your sentence is:

"they will understand my XXXXX.".

there's no word XXXXX. here's a sentence that would be correctly written as:

"they will understand me as the XXXXX.".

if you were to make an adverb out of the apostrophe, then it could appear anywhere in your sentence, and it would be correct.  if you were to make an exclamation point in the middle of your sentence, then it would look like a question mark.  
or, if you were to try to use an apostrophe with a question mark, you would be confusing yourself. 
if you had wanted to make a quote without using an apostrophe, you would probably write:

"i will understand you as the obrptitiously, and as the obrptitiously, and as the XXXXX, and as the XXXXX.".

there is nothing wrong with doing this, except you might get confusing results.
